pr_body:
Fixes #10235

This commit updates the Cobra command logic around extension upgrade checks to be non-blocking.

Previously, we were waiting for 1 second after the extension completed to allow the update checking logic complete, however users want the GitHub CLI to run as far as possible.

cc: @williammartin

pr_comments:
I was discussing this with @jtmcg and @BagToad earlier this afternoon as I struggled with a better way to test that this behavior works as expected.

The best approach with the current extension and Cobra architecture was crafting a test that would panic / fail if the underlying Cobra logic waiting on update check was blocking.  I'm open to ideas on how to refactor this for confidence.

issue_context.title: Extension update notices should be non-blocking
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

After #9934 was merged, @williammartin called out a problem where the logic handling extension updates is blocking, which will cause the user to wait an indeterminate amount of time for `gh` to check if a new version is available: 

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/112552fec126813b2d290f034612e0ec6937485f/pkg/cmd/root/extension.go#L53-L70

This was a mistake on the author's part as the update checking logic should be non-blocking like it is with core `gh` update checking:

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/112552fec126813b2d290f034612e0ec6937485f/internal/ghcmd/cmd.go#L174-L191

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Create simple extension for testing

   ```shell
   gh ext create gh-sleep
   cd gh-sleep
   gh repo create --push --private --source .
   gh ext install andyfeller/gh-sleep
   ```

1. Artificially extend extension update check behavior

   ```
   diff --git a/pkg/cmd/root/extension.go b/pkg/cmd/root/extension.go
   index 7f2325e1..95d4669d 100644
   --- a/pkg/cmd/root/extension.go
   +++ b/pkg/cmd/root/extension.go
   @@ -32,6 +32,9 @@ func NewCmdExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ex
                   // PreRun handles looking up whether extension has a latest version only when the command is ran.
                   PreRun: func(c *cobra.Command, args []string) {
                           go func() {
   +                               fmt.Fprintf(io.ErrOut, "Artifically delaying update check logic, sleeping for 3 minutes")
   +                               time.Sleep(3 * time.Minute)
   +                               fmt.Fprintf(io.ErrOut, "Artifically delay up!")
                                   releaseInfo, err := checkExtensionReleaseInfo(em, ext)
                                   if err != nil && hasDebug {
                                           fmt.Fprintf(io.ErrOut, "warning: checking for update failed: %v", err)
   ```

1. Build and run extension, confirming blocking behavior

   ```shell
   make
   time ./bin/gh sleep
   ```
  
   resulting in:
  
   ```
   Artifically delaying update check logic, sleeping for 3 minutes
   Hello gh-sleep!
   Artifically delay up!
   ./bin/gh sleep  0.05s user 0.02s system 0% cpu 3:00.06 total
   ```

### Expected vs actual behavior

Again, extension update checking logic should be non-blocking.

review_comments: Suggest not panicking from something that can be in a goroutine, called from a test, it can fail tests that are running later.
Definitely would not have landed on that approach! 😮  I also attempted to explain what is going on by redoing the comments as best as I could; feel free to correct and suggest improvements.
